Tier 1 — Schmidt, unabbreviated

No paraphrase. Every change here is mechanical and reversible: the headword put back where Schmidt shortened it to an initial, his abbreviations spelled out, play names written in full, the folio-and-quarto apparatus lifted out of the reading line, and each sense given its own block.

Left is exactly what Schmidt printed. Right is the same words, re-inflated. The definitions are untouched — where the right column still reads oddly (“the plant Calluna vulgaris”), that is Schmidt's own wording, and only a Tier 2 rewrite would change it.
